agenda: NEW PROGRAM NORTH STAR (Peter, 2026-08-19): generalization means performance BEYOND the training distribution -- coverage expansion is the null hypothesis, not the achievement. The prior multi-family result is hereby reframed as a coverage demonstration. Goal: an architecture that generalizes better than state of the art, with the measurement framework built FIRST.

measurement_framework.G1_data_scaling: in-family error vs n_train on a FIXED 48-case val split: the comparison object is the scaling CURVE (log-log slope + small-n intercept), not any single point. Structure that means anything must show at small n.
measurement_framework.G2_transfer_vs_data: zero-shot error on two held-out families as a function of n_train (same lanes, free): does structure change the transfer curve's shape, or only its coverage-limited asymptote?
measurement_framework.G3_ood_factors: the procedurally-generated 2D suite (exact solutions, parametric BCs) revived for MT2-vs-GeoTransolver: train on a BC-parameter range, test beyond it -- amplitude extrapolation, unseen BC shapes, unseen geometry classes. Designed second, after G1/G2 land (needs model-agnostic harness work).
measurement_framework.G4_group_orbit: already measured (P1): exact generalization over declared groups; the existence proof that declared structure buys true OOD. Kept as the ledger's anchor.
measurement_framework.sota_criterion: MT2-class beats GeoTransolver on the G1 slope or small-n intercept AND on G2 shape, at equal protocol, without losing the full-data point -- curve dominance, not point dominance.

stage_A_arms.ladder: n_train in {14, 27, 54, 109, 218} NESTED seeded subsets of DrivAerML's 435 (n=435 points reuse the existing gt_fixed / mt2_v3c 5-seed runs)
stage_A_arms.runs: {gt, mt2_v3c-config} x 5 ladder rungs x 2 seeds (42, 43) = 20 lanes, frozen protocol (500 epochs -- epochs, not steps, held fixed; the protocol confound of fewer steps at small n is DECLARED and will be probed with one double-epoch control at n=54 per architecture)
stage_A_arms.instrument: fixed 48-case val at 10k (G1) + estate/fastback smoke (G2), identical to every prior wave

predictions.G1: MT2's small-n intercept is better (structure regularizes when data is scarce), p ~ 0.5 -- genuinely uncertain, which is the point; GeoTransolver's full-data point stays best or tied
predictions.G2: both transfer curves are flat at mean-predictor level for all n (transfer is coverage-limited at every scale we can test), p ~ 0.6; ANY downward slope for either architecture would be the program's first evidence of architecture-driven cross-family generalization
